A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Sim-DETR work, and all 12 pages of each are readable, including figures, tables and equations. Both reference Appendices C, D, E and G, but neither supplied PDF contains appendix pages; no unprovided appendix content is assessed.

before.justification: v1 reports original Sim-DETR benchmark results, diagnostic experiments and ablations in Figures 2–5 and Tables 1–5.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, diagnostic experiments and ablations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 retain the same architecture, Query Grouping and Ranking, Global-Local Bridging, IoU head and training losses. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions retain temporal sentence grounding evaluations on QVHighlights, Charades-STA and TACoS. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding Tables 1–3, including the separate VGG and I3D comparisons. Section 3 also retains the same CG-DETR and TaskWeave comparisons.

E3.justification: The QVHighlights validation analyses, query/layer sweeps, evaluation metrics, feature extractors and 200-epoch training budget remain unchanged. Text crossing different page or column boundaries does not introduce new settings.

E4.justification: Figures 2–5 retain the same query/layer sensitivity, query similarity, matching consistency and attention analyses. Tables 4–5 retain identical component and conflict-metric ablations.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate tables and descriptive plots. Neither reports new run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and results displayed in Figures 2–5 are unchanged. For example, Sim-DETR's QVHighlights test and validation average mAP remain 46.93 and 49.50, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), the overall loss, mathematical definitions and accompanying reasoning are unchanged. Equation spacing and placement change without revising their mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about two query conflicts, two decoder modifications, benchmark superiority, robustness to additional queries/layers and faster convergence.

C2.justification: The explanations involving shared segment semantics, global/local conflicts and ablation outcomes are unchanged. No substantive interpretation, applicability qualification or limitation is added.

D1.justification: The abstract's advertised GitHub code location changes from nagara214/Sim-DETR to SooLab/Sim-DETR, including the hyperlink destination. Other implementation disclosures remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether code contents or accessibility changed.

R1.justification: All 85 reference entries and the research positioning are retained. Changes to citation-page backreferences reflect pagination rather than added or removed prior work.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes from v1 dated 28 September 2025 to v2 dated 24 November 2025. Scientific prose, terminology, section headings and logical ordering are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Line wrapping, equation spacing and column/page breaks change; the conclusion moves from page 9 to page 8. All seven figures and five tables retain their content, captions and display structure.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the scientific methods, evidence, claims and explanations. The changed code destination and minor typesetting adjustments establish no meaningful overall quality improvement or decline; improved code access cannot be established from the PDFs. References to absent appendices remain unresolved in both.
